scripts.check-types: turbo run check-types && bun run check-types:root && bun run check:effect
scripts.dev: turbo run build --filter=api && CI=1 ALCHEMY_HOME=.alchemy/native-apps-auth ALCHEMY_TELEMETRY_DISABLED=1 BUN_OPTIONS=--no-env-file alchemy dev --stage dev_native_apps
scripts.lint: bun run format:check && bun run lint:boundary-directives && oxlint -c oxlint.config.ts . --type-aware --disable-nested-config --no-error-on-unmatched-pattern && bun run check:docs && bun run check:repository-paths
scripts.pr:deploy: sh -c 'stage="$1"; printf %s "$stage" | grep -Eqx "pr-[1-9][0-9]{0,6}" || { echo "pr:deploy needs a pr-<number> stage" >&2; exit 64; }; shift; for arg in "$@"; do case "$arg" in --stage|--stage=*) echo "pr:deploy takes the stage only as its first argument" >&2; exit 64;; esac; done; bun run build && exec alchemy deploy --stage "$stage" "$@"' pr:deploy
scripts.pr:destroy: sh -c 'stage="$1"; printf %s "$stage" | grep -Eqx "pr-[1-9][0-9]{0,6}" || { echo "pr:destroy needs a pr-<number> stage" >&2; exit 64; }; shift; for arg in "$@"; do case "$arg" in --stage|--stage=*) echo "pr:destroy takes the stage only as its first argument" >&2; exit 64;; esac; done; bun run build --filter=api && exec alchemy destroy --stage "$stage" "$@"' pr:destroy
scripts.pr:plan: sh -c 'stage="$1"; printf %s "$stage" | grep -Eqx "pr-[1-9][0-9]{0,6}" || { echo "pr:plan needs a pr-<number> stage" >&2; exit 64; }; shift; for arg in "$@"; do case "$arg" in --stage|--stage=*) echo "pr:plan takes the stage only as its first argument" >&2; exit 64;; esac; done; bun run build --filter=api && exec alchemy plan --stage "$stage" "$@"' pr:plan
scripts.production:deploy: bun run build && alchemy deploy --stage prod
scripts.production:plan: bun run build --filter=api && alchemy plan --stage prod
scripts.release:check: bun run verification && bun run sdk:check-packed-artifact && bun run sdk:validate-downstream && bun run api:smoke && bun run changeset:status
scripts.test: bun run test:tools && turbo run test && turbo run test:browser && bun run test:native
scripts.test:native: bun run --filter=web build:native-pair && bun run --filter=web test:native-pair
scripts.verification: bun run build && bun run lint && bun run check-types && bun run knip && bun run test
